designation: chránený strom, protected tree under Slovak nature conservation law

attribution: Štátna ochrana prírody Slovenskej republiky, extract of 2026-08-16
scope: 1199 protected-tree designations nationwide, per-tree point coordinates.
caveat: No age, girth or vitality field. Pocet_stromov says how many trees a designation covers, and anything above 1 is a group carrying publishable=false under the collectible-point rule. Species is the Slovak common name (Druh), so the binomial is a per-tree lookup. Every entry links to its own state-register page at data.sopsr.sk, which is a ready second source.
